rationale: All parties now agree on the need for a negotiated restructuring and some form of burden-sharing, but the core conflict remains unresolved: management and investors insist closures and durable capacity cuts must stay on the table, while labour and the state shareholder maintain red lines against German plant closures and forced redundancies. Positions are more clearly articulated but not substantively converged, so further rounds could still test trade-offs and narrow the gap.
